thread:
jenna_support: Hey team — Customer support ticket #51288 reporting dashboard legend colors not matching series on mobile. They say the legend labels appear in a different order and tooltips show 'requests_per_min' when hovering 'latency_p50'. Screenshot attached: https://redwood-attachments/51288/legend_mismatch.png

mike_eng: Thanks — can you paste repro steps? Is this the new analytics chart build we shipped last night? :thinking_face:

jenna_support: Steps I followed from the ticket: 1) Open Console > Analytics > API usage 2) Set timeframe = Last 24h 3) Filter by project: acme-retail 4) View on iPhone Safari (iOS 16) Result: legend colors don't match lines, and tapping a series shows wrong tooltip metric.

emily_frontend: Ugh. That sounds like the legend-color mapping index got out of sync with the series array after we started de-duplicating hidden series in mobile collapse. Possible CSS reflow or array mutation bug. Can you confirm browser JS console logs?

jenna_support: Customer sent console log snippet: ```TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined at renderLegend (analytics.bundle.js:45)``` Also they noted a 500 error earlier when loading metrics: `GET /api/metrics?project=acme-retail&range=24h -> 500`

laura_pm: Flagging as P1 for UX (affects billing/usage understanding). Related to new mobile legend collapse work we rolled yesterday in canary. Laura -> mike/emily please triage with priority.

mike_eng: On it. Quick hypothesis: backend returned an empty series for the `latency_p50` timeslice when a few shards timed out; frontend code filters null series but doesn't keep mapping indexes, causing mismatch. Rafael, did SLOs or shard timeouts spike around 2026-03-10 02:10 UTC?

rafael_sre: We had a brief spike at 02:09 UTC — several metric workers timed out to redis for ~30s while autoscaler scaled up. I can share traces: trace-id=tr-9f2a. Also saw 502 from metrics-collector.

deploy-bot: Deployment complete: analytics-ui v3.14.2 rolled to canary at 2026-03-10T02:05:12Z

emily_frontend: Ok reproduction locally: when metrics array contains a null entry we do `series.map((s, i) => <Legend key={i} color={colors[i]} .../>)` which misaligns after filter. Fix: compute color mapping from series IDs instead of index. I'll open a PR.

mike_eng: Can you add defensive checks and guard against undefined length first? Also add a unit test for mobile collapse path. If the 500 on metrics API repros we should fallback to previous cached series rather than render broken legend.

jenna_support: Customer asked for ETA — they are using dashboard during high-traffic period and worried about billing/usage misreading. Any ETA?

laura_pm: Emily aim for hotfix branch and deploy to canary in 2 hours. If green, push to prod within 6 hours. Communicate to CS to notify customer.

emily_frontend: Working on PR now: short-term patch + unit tests. Will ping when canary build is up. Patch includes: 1) skip undefined series earlier, 2) stable color mapping by series id, 3) small tooltip guard to fallback to metric name if field missing.

mike_eng: Rafael can you check if we should replay missing metrics for that time window or mark them as partial? We need to avoid showing incorrect numbers in the tooltip.

rafael_sre: I can trigger a retry job for the window 2026-03-10T02:05-02:15 UTC, but if the collector returned 500 upstream we may be missing points. I'll coordinate with metrics team and update runbook.

jenna_support: Great — I told customer we have a hotfix planned and will update in ~2 hours. They appreciated the quick response :thumbsup:

emily_frontend: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2789 — includes test and screenshot of mobile legend fixed. Will kick off canary deploy once CI green.

mike_eng: Once canary passes, let's enable verbose logging for legend render on mobile for 24h so we can catch any leftover edge cases. Also add alert if series length mismatch >2 between legend and chart.

jenna_support: Thanks everyone. I'll update ticket #51288 with the plan and timeline.
